description: Four bronze horses with chariot. Must have been heavy to move. I took this pic in summer 2005. There were 2 of these bronze sculptures found together. Both of them with 4 horses. Together they are the largest bronze sculpture found in the world. When discovered, they were broken into more than 16,000 pieces. Now they are completely restored
